amostra: Olá! Eu vou ler esta história com você. Vire a página quando quiser!
nomes: Robin Hood, Lady Mariana, João Pequeno, Grilo, Mestre Tomé, Clara Escarlate, Xerife de Nortigão, Rei Ricardo, Xervedo, Nortigão, Vila do Moinho, Grande Carvalho, Riacho Fundo, Torre Velha, Bando Verde

NARRADORA.estilo: warm, gentle storyteller reading aloud to young children; calm, clear pace; expressive but not theatrical

ROBIN.estilo: brave, cheerful young archer speaking up with spirit and warmth; clear, lively and confident, never aggressive

MARIANA.estilo: clever, warm and confident young woman of the forest, calm mentor voice, encouraging and alert

JOAO_PEQUENO.estilo: big, hearty gentle giant with a booming, warm voice and an easy laugh, friendly and jovial

GRILO.estilo: lively, curious young boy speaking with excitement and affection, playful and bright

MESTRE_TOME.estilo: gentle, honest older village miller, humble and calm, speaking with quiet dignity and love for his son

CLARA.estilo: bright, spirited, creative young craftswoman, cheerful and clever with a playful sparkle

XERIFE.estilo: pompous, grumpy, self-important medieval sheriff barking orders, comic villain, blustery and theatrical, never truly scary

REI_RICARDO.estilo: jolly, pampered, well-meaning but oblivious king clapping his hands cheerfully, grand and breezy

VIZINHOS.estilo: villagers whispering in agreement together, lively and supportive

GUARDA_PRACA.estilo: alert castle guard shouting an alarm in the square, startled and urgent

VIZINHA_FEIRANTE.estilo: kind older market neighbor whispering worriedly about what she saw, warm and helpful

GUARDA_TORRE.estilo: sleepy guard letting out a comical sneeze in his sleep

VOVO.estilo: sweet, playful grandmother chuckling warmly as she peeks at a pile of blankets

MENININHO.estilo: excited little boy shouting joyfully while pretending to be a hero

VIZINHO_VARANDA.estilo: proud, grateful villager chatting warmly from the porch, cheerful and appreciative

PALAVRAS.estilo: literacy teacher: each syllable slowly and clearly separated with short pauses, then the whole word joyfully
